It was established in 2017. College is affiliated to RAJIV GANDHI UNIVERSITY OF HEALTH SCIENCEs. Mission of the college is to bring the quality health care including underprivileged people and so give the best educational quality and stress free period for the students

MBBS: East Point Medical College Bangalore offers only one course in this campus i.e., MBBS. The college has other campuses for other courses like nursing ,business and many others mentioned above. MBBS is a undergraduate degree. one can join MBBS after 12th and one can proceed MD after MBBS
MBBS is total 5 and half year course that is – Four and half years

One year internship – Internship program is also a compulsory part of MBBS . It is a period in MBBS where you work as a doctor in the hospital . interns in the hospitals are more exposed to the patient and work in hospitals with minimum salary. Internships can be done in the hospital of your choice .eg – in case you don’t want to continue in east point medical college you can ask for transfer in the college of your choice .
Departments: The Anatomy department of the college has various collections of species and human body parts like ( brain ,lungs ,tongue ,face etc.) for study purposes . In fact , this is the first thing you do after joining college in the first year . department also has skulls and bones of the body ,charts and models for better learning . department also have microscopes and histology slides.

Physiology is one of the first three practical in MBBS(first year)and physiology is a branch of biology that deals with normal functions of the human body and life, basic things that you will need for life will thought in this lab like measurement of blood pressure ,pulse rate, hematology test. lab of physiology in east point medical college is well equipped and four practical halls just for physiology with modern microscopes and equipment for practical.

Biochemistry is a science that deals with chemical and physio-chemical processes and substances that occur within living organisms. teachers in biochemistry lab will teach you about chemicals and experiments like differential tests for blood sugars ,chemical examination of normal urine, test for jaundice( liver function test). Lab in east point medical college is huge and has a single hall which can accommodate 100 students. Lab is facilitated with all the equipment and audio – visual smart screens.

Pathology is a branch of science that deals with study of disease and diagnosis through removed tissue. lab in east point medical college of pathology is equipped with modern diagnostic aids for investigations and hematology instruments. department has a museum that has a collection of various number of spices of diseased organs and chart and models for better understanding. Pathology lab also has around 100 microscopes for studying slides.
Microbiology is a branch of science that deals with study of microorganisms and morphology of the microorganisms. lab has one single hall that can accommodate 75 students staining.

Pharmacology is a branch of medical science that deals with the study of drugs and its mechanism. Pharmacology is one of the interesting practicals of MBBS. Lab is totally equipped for drug preparation. Equipment used in college are verified and safe.

The department teaches the legal aspect of medical practice to students that helps in resolution of criminal cases on the basis of scientific facts. The department has access to laboratories and seminar rooms. For forensic study the lab is facilitated with microscope ,x-ray machines. Age estimation is learnt by x -rays and the main aspect that help in study of the criminal case is dentition of the criminal ,bite marks and lip bite. tooth molds and OPG are given for studies. Department also has a museum that has a collection of various bones, forensic cases and photographs, snake specimens and different types of weapons.

Community medicine department is all about serving the rural population by offering them medical service. The department of east point medical college conducts at least two camps every week .The department is equipped with smart TVs for displaying content in the form of videos and pictures for better understanding of students and patients. Department also has computers for statistical cells, community medicine has a number of charts ,posters and survey cases for better understanding about health issues and hygiene importance and educating patients for the same.

East Point Hospital & Services: Hospital is located on the campus of East Point Medical College Bangalore. since this college belongs to the college . staff of the college are doctors in the hospital and interns work under the staff .staff and interns (residents) help the students. The hospital has all the facilities for students and patients.
Emergency service: Emergency department works 24×7 with OPD which is also attached to 10 labor beds and 10 emergency beds equipped with oxygen supply , oximeter, crash carts ,monitors and minor operation theaters
OPD (outpatient department): All departments like general medicine ,general surgery, ENT, derma, ophthalmology ,dental, psychiatry have their own OPD service and there is also general OPD from where patient are sent to respective departments and there are 24 beds distribution among these departments
Diagnostic facilities: All the diagnostic services are available at a single laboratory.it has all three departments attached to it microbiology, pathology and biochemistry. Laboratory is totally modernized and provides accurate results in short period and open 24 x7
Radiology: Department of radiology has 2 portable x ray machines frequency ranging from 300mA,600mA, and 800mA.Also has ultrasound machines and CT Scan
ICU (intensive care unit): ICU has total 35 beds in number and also works 24 x 7 with physicians and intensivists, bedside nurses and anesthesiologists is particularized and specified with all equipment, especially ventilators.

Other departments – The college has all the departments like blood bank ,pharmacy, operation theaters, gynecology, ambulance service, department of dentistry. Departments are fully facilitated and punctual providing great service to patients and humanity.
On-Campus Facilities Offered: ➤ campus – East Point Medical college has vast campus area.it is located in the outskirts of city ,surrounded by green and campus is spacious, parking facilities are available in campus only, environment is very pleasant especially studying which keep students fresh.

➤ classrooms – The college has 4 theaters with light and ventilation. Classrooms have centralized air conditioners ,smart class, white and green board, metallic chairs and table. There are separate demo classes in every department with basic white boards and chairs.

➤ laboratories – The college has separate labs for separate departments which are also very ventilated and hygienic. All the safety measures have been taken in construction and maintenance .There are well equipped and students are provided with all the materials for experiments and practical.
➤ Auditoriums – Very spacious , can accommodate more than 400 people , college conducts various events here such as graduation ,intra and inter college fest ,freshers and small celebrations.

➤ Playground – The college has not too big but it is quite a playground on campus. you can play a sport of your choice in the playground. Volleyball, throwball, football nets are available. people enjoy playing cricket here mostly. sports events are conducted in the playground every year.
